title: Add webhook signature verification (HMAC) for GitHub webhooks
description:
Implement HMAC signature verification for GitHub webhook requests to prevent unauthorized webhook calls. This validates that webhook POSTs actually come from GitHub using X-Hub-Signature-256 header.

Currently webhook endpoints accept any POST without verification. Need crypto.timingSafeEqual comparison of computed vs received HMAC using webhook secret.

steps: CHECK backend/src/config.ts for environment variable pattern

acceptanceCriteria: HMAC signature verification middleware added to webhook routes
Uses Node.js crypto module with timingSafeEqual
Invalid signatures return 401 with error message

doNotCreate: backend/src/middleware/webhookAuth.ts - add middleware inline to routes file, reuse Express patterns from existing routes
backend/src/utils/crypto.ts - use Node.js crypto module directly in routes file, no wrapper needed
